WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR JUSTICE M.NAGAPRASANNA  ORAL ORDER Heard the learned counsel Sri.Mohan Kumar D., appearing for the petitioners, Sri.Rangaswamy R.,
the learned High Court Government Pleader appearing for respondent No.1 and the learned counsel Sri.Vinod Kumar M., appearing for respondent No.2.
2.

The petitioners are before this Court calling in question the proceedings in C.C.No.18022/2023 for offences punishable under Sections 307, 498A, 506 and 201 read with Section 34 of the IPC and Sections 3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961.
During the pendency of this petition, the parties to the lis i.e., husband and wife have settled the dispute amongst themselves and drawn up a memorandum of settlement.

The settlement insofar as it germane to the present lis, reads as follows:
"9.

In view of the settlement arrived between the parties the parties have agreed to withdraw/quash/close the following cases as per the prevailing law of the land, they are:
Devaraju B C vs State Of Karnataka on 6 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/38879288/

sentences.text:
a) The petitioner has filed Crime No.194/2022 Basaveshwaranagar Police Station,
Bengaluru which is pending before the 24th ACMM, Bengaluru.

b) The respondent has filed Crime No.191/2022 Wison Garden Police Station,
Bengaluru against the petitioner and his parents which is pending before the VI-ACMM, Bengaluru and now numbered as S.C No.344/2024 on the file of City Civil and Sessions Judge, CCH-46, Bengaluru.

entities.text: City Civil and Sessions Judge, CCH-46, Bengaluru
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
c) The respondent has filed C.Misc No.40/2023 against the petitioner and his parents which is pending before III MMTC, Bengaluru and also filed Crl.A.No.694/2023 and Crl.A No.454/2024 on the file of the City Civil and Sessions Judge, CCH-67,
Bengaluru,
d)
The respondent has filed O.S. No.7553/2022 against the petitioner and her father pending on the file of the City Civil and Sessions Judge, CCH-3, Bengaluru.

entities.text: City Civil and Sessions Judge, CCH-3, Bengaluru
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
e) Both the parties have agreed to co-operate to close WP.No.21588/2023 and W.P.No.21568/2023 pending before the Hon'ble High Karnataka, Bengaluru and get the NC: 2024:KHC:44775 offences compounded and close the cases respectively."
4.
An application for compounding in the light of the settlement is also filed and the same is taken on record.

5. In the light of the settlement arrived at between the parties and the offences not being against the State, I deem it appropriate to accept the application seeking compounding of offences and terminate the proceedings, qua the petitioners.
6. For the aforesaid reasons, the petition is disposed.
The proceedings in C.C.No.18022/2023 pending on the file of the VI Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Bengaluru, qua the petitioners, stand quashed.
